(a) 证明:对于在 7.2.1 节中学习过的二重简井，在简并微扰理论中，波函数的一阶修正是

$$
\psi^ {1} = \sum_ {m \neq a, b} \frac {\alpha V _ {m a} + \beta V _ {m b}}{E ^ {0} - E _ {m} ^ {0}} \psi_ {m} ^ {0}.
$$

(b) 考虑 $\lambda ^ { 2 }$ 项(对应非简并情况中的方程 (7.8))，证明: $\alpha$ 和 $\beta$ 可以通过求 $w ^ { 2 }$ (上标表示二阶符号而不是 $w$ 的平方)矩阵的本征矢来确定，其中

$$
\left[ \pmb {\mathscr {W}} ^ {2} \right] _ {i j} = \sum_ {m \neq a, b} \frac {\left\langle \psi_ {i} ^ {0} \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {m} ^ {0} \right\rangle \left\langle \psi_ {m} ^ {0} \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {j} ^ {0} \right\rangle}{E ^ {0} - E _ {m} ^ {0}},
$$

并且该矩阵的本征值对应于二阶能量 $E ^ { 2 }$

(c) 证明:在 (b) 中发展的二阶简并微扰理论为习题 7.39 中的三态哈密顿量给出了正确的能量二阶修正.

证明 (a) $\left( H ^ { 0 } - E _ { n } ^ { 0 } \right) \psi _ { n } ^ { 1 } = - \left( H ^ { 1 } - E _ { n } ^ { 1 } \right) \psi _ { n } ^ { 0 }$ ，其中 $\psi _ { n } ^ { 1 }$ 为一阶微扰披函数，是无微扰本征波函数 $\psi _ { n } ^ { 0 }$ 的线性组合.上式两边左乘 $\psi _ { m } ^ { 0 }$ $m \neq n )$ 并积分，得

$$
E _ {m} ^ {0} \left\langle \psi_ {m} ^ {0} | \psi_ {n} ^ {1} \right\rangle - E _ {n} ^ {0} \left\langle \psi_ {m} ^ {0} | \psi_ {n} ^ {1} \right\rangle = - \left\langle \psi_ {m} ^ {0} \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {n} ^ {0} \right\rangle + E _ {n} ^ {1} \left\langle \psi_ {m} ^ {0} | \psi_ {n} ^ {0} \right\rangle ,
$$

其中 $\left. \psi _ { m } ^ { 0 } | \psi _ { n } ^ { 0 } \right. = 0$ .

(ψ H' ?Þ~) 因此， (ψ |ψ;)- zz-E · $\left. { \psi _ { m } ^ { 0 } } | { \psi _ { n } ^ { 1 } } \right. = { \frac { \left. { \psi _ { m } ^ { 0 } } \right| H ^ { \prime } \left| { \psi _ { n } ^ { 0 } } \right. } { E _ { n } ^ { 0 } - E _ { m } ^ { 0 } } }$

令 $\psi _ { n } ^ { 0 } = \alpha \psi _ { a } ^ { 0 } + \beta \psi _ { b } ^ { 0 }$ ，则

$$
\left\langle \psi_ {m} ^ {0} \mid \psi_ {n} ^ {1} \right\rangle = \frac {\left\langle \psi_ {m} ^ {0} \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \alpha \psi_ {a} ^ {0} + \beta \psi_ {b} ^ {0} \right\rangle}{E _ {n} ^ {0} - E _ {m} ^ {0}} = \frac {\alpha H _ {m a} ^ {\prime} + \beta H _ {m b} ^ {\prime}}{E _ {n} ^ {0} - E _ {m} ^ {0}}.
$$

所以，一阶修正波函数为

$$
\psi_ {n} ^ {1} = \sum_ {m \neq a, b} \frac {\alpha H _ {m a} ^ {\prime} + \beta H _ {m b} ^ {\prime}}{E _ {n} ^ {0} - E _ {m} ^ {0}} \psi_ {m} ^ {0}.
$$

由于考虑的是一个筒并能级，可以将指标 $n$ 去掉，为保持与题目一致，可将 $H ^ { \prime }$ 换成 $V$ ，得

$$
\psi^ {1} = \sum_ {m \neq a, b} \frac {\alpha V _ {m a} + \beta V _ {m b}}{E ^ {0} - E _ {m} ^ {0}} \psi_ {m} ^ {0}.
$$

二阶修正等式为

$$
H ^ {0} \psi_ {n} ^ {2} + H ^ {\prime} \psi_ {n} ^ {1} = E _ {n} ^ {0} \psi_ {n} ^ {2} + E _ {n} ^ {1} \psi_ {n} ^ {1} + E _ {n} ^ {2} \psi_ {n} ^ {0},
$$

令 $\psi _ { n }$ 为 $\psi$ ，分别采用 $\psi _ { a } ^ { 0 }$ 和 $\psi _ { b } ^ { 0 }$ 乘以上式左边并进行内积，得

$$
\left\langle \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \right| H ^ {0} \left| \psi^ {2} \right\rangle + \left\langle \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi^ {1} \right\rangle = E ^ {0} \left\langle \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \mid \psi^ {2} \right\rangle + E ^ {1} \left\langle \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \mid \psi^ {1} \right\rangle + E ^ {2} \left\langle \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \mid \psi^ {0} \right\rangle ,
$$

$$
E ^ {0} \left\langle \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \mid \psi^ {2} \right\rangle + \left\langle \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi^ {1} \right\rangle = E ^ {0} \left\langle \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \mid \psi^ {2} \right\rangle + E ^ {1} \left\langle \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \mid \psi^ {1} \right\rangle + E ^ {2} \left\langle \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \mid \psi^ {0} \right\rangle .
$$

由于 $\psi ^ { 0 } = \alpha \psi _ { a } ^ { 0 } + \beta \psi _ { b } ^ { 0 }$ 所以 $\left. \psi _ { a } ^ { 0 } \mid \psi ^ { 0 } \right. = \alpha$ 因此，上式可化简为

$$
\left\langle \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi^ {1} \right\rangle = \alpha E ^ {2}.
$$

同理，可得 $\left. \psi _ { b } ^ { 0 } \right| H ^ { \prime } \left| \psi ^ { 1 } \right. = \beta E ^ { 2 }$

(a) 中的结论 $\psi ^ { 1 } = \sum _ { m \neq a , b } \frac { \alpha H _ { m a } ^ { \prime } + \beta H _ { m b } ^ { \prime } } { E ^ { 0 } - E _ { m } ^ { 0 } } \psi _ { m } ^ { 0 }$ 代入以上两式，得

$$
\sum_ {m \neq a, b} \frac {\alpha H _ {m a} ^ {\prime} + \beta H _ {m b} ^ {\prime}}{E ^ {0} - E _ {m} ^ {0}} \left\langle \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {m} ^ {0} \right\rangle = \sum_ {m \neq a, b} \frac {\alpha H _ {m a} ^ {\prime} + \beta H _ {m b} ^ {\prime}}{E ^ {0} - E _ {m} ^ {0}} H _ {a m} ^ {\prime} = \alpha E ^ {2},
$$

$$
\sum_ {m \neq a, b} \frac {\alpha H _ {m a} ^ {\prime} + \beta H _ {m b} ^ {\prime}}{E ^ {0} - E _ {m} ^ {0}} \left<   \psi_ {b} ^ {0} \left. \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \right. \psi_ {m} ^ {0} \right> = \sum_ {m \neq a, b} \frac {\alpha H _ {m a} ^ {\prime} + \beta H _ {m b} ^ {\prime}}{E ^ {0} - E _ {m} ^ {0}} H _ {b m} ^ {\prime} = \beta E ^ {2}.
$$

将两式结合起来，可以写为

$$
\sum_ {m \neq a, b} \frac {1}{E ^ {0} - E _ {m} ^ {0}} \left( \begin{array}{c c} | H _ {m a} ^ {\prime} | ^ {2} & H _ {a m} ^ {\prime} H _ {m b} ^ {\prime} \\ H _ {b m} ^ {\prime} H _ {m a} ^ {\prime} & | H _ {m b} ^ {\prime} | ^ {2} \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c} \alpha \\ \beta \end{array} \right) = E ^ {2} \left( \begin{array}{c} \alpha \\ \beta \end{array} \right).
$$

做代换 $a , b  i , j$ ，得

$$
\left[ \pmb {\mathscr {W}} ^ {2} \right] _ {i j} = \sum_ {m \neq a, b} \frac {\left<   \psi_ {i} ^ {0} \left. \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {m} ^ {0} \right> \left<   \psi_ {m} ^ {0} \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \right. \psi_ {j} ^ {0} \right > }{E ^ {0} - E _ {m} ^ {0}}.
$$

(c) 对应于习题 7.39，如矩阵元 $H _ { m a } ^ { \prime } , a = 1 , m = 3$ 时，

$$
H _ {3 1} ^ {\prime} = \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 0 & 0 & 1 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 0 & 0 & V \\ 0 & 0 & V \\ V ^ {*} & V ^ {*} & 0 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c} 1 \\ 0 \\ 0 \end{array} \right) = V ^ {*}.
$$

所以，

$$
\left| H _ {3 1} ^ {\prime} \right| ^ {2} = | V | ^ {2}.
$$

同理，可得 $H _ { 1 3 } ^ { \prime } H _ { 3 2 } ^ { \prime } = | V | ^ { 2 } , H _ { 2 3 } ^ { \prime } H _ { 3 1 } ^ { \prime } = | V | ^ { 2 }$ 和 $| H _ { 3 2 } ^ { \prime } | ^ { 2 } = | V | ^ { 2 }$ .

困此 $w ^ { 2 }$ 矩阵为

$$
\boldsymbol {\mathcal {W}} ^ {2} = \frac {1}{\varepsilon_ {a} - \varepsilon_ {c}} \left( \begin{array}{c c} | V | ^ {2} & | V | ^ {2} \\ | V | ^ {2} & | V | ^ {2} \end{array} \right).
$$

对应的本征矢为

$$
\frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \left(1 \pm 1\right),
$$

因此，呀"的量子态为性 $\psi _ { \pm } ^ { 0 } = \frac { \psi _ { a } ^ { 0 } \pm \psi _ { b } ^ { 0 } } { \sqrt { 2 } }$

简并能级的二阶修正由 $w ^ { 2 }$ 矩阵的久期方程得出

$$
\frac {1}{\varepsilon_ {a} - \varepsilon_ {c}} \left| \begin{array}{c c} {| V | ^ {2} - E ^ {\prime 2}} & {| V | ^ {2}} \\ {| V | ^ {2}} & {| V | ^ {2} - E ^ {\prime 2}} \end{array} \right| = 0.
$$

因此 $E _ { + } ^ { 2 } = { \frac { E _ { + } ^ { \prime 2 } } { \varepsilon _ { a } - \varepsilon _ { c } } } = 2 { \frac { | V | ^ { 2 } } { \varepsilon _ { a } - \varepsilon _ { c } } }$ 和 $E _ { - } ^ { 2 } = 0$ .

事*习题 7.41 质量为 $m$ 的自由粒子限制在周长为 $L$ 的圆环上，满足 $\psi ( x + L ) =$ $\psi \left( x \right)$ 无微扰哈密顿量为

考虑一对简并态 $n = \pm 1$ .构建 $w$ 矩阵并计算一阶能量修正 $E ^ { 1 }$ 注意在阶微扰下简并没有消除.因此，对角化 $w$ 矩阵并不能给出什么是"好"态.

a) 薛定诲方程为

$$
- \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 m} \frac {\mathrm {d} ^ {2}}{\mathrm {d} x ^ {2}} \psi (x) = E \psi (x),
$$

$$
\frac {\mathrm {d} ^ {2}}{\mathrm {d} x ^ {2}} \psi (x) + \frac {2 m E}{\hbar^ {2}} \psi (x) = 0,
$$

k=V $k = { \sqrt { \frac { 2 m E } { \hbar ^ { 2 } } } } .$

$$
\frac {\mathrm {d} ^ {2}}{\mathrm {d} x ^ {2}} \psi (x) + k ^ {2} \psi (x) = 0,
$$

所以，

$$
\psi (x) = A \mathrm {e} ^ {\mathrm {i} k x};
$$

根据边界条件 $\psi \left( 0 \right) = \psi \left( L \right)$ ，可得 $\mathrm { e } ^ { \mathrm { i } k L } = 1 , k L = 2 n \pi \ ( n = 0 , \pm 1 , \pm 2 , \cdot \cdot \cdot )$ ，所以，

$$
\psi_ {n} ^ {0} (x) = \frac {1}{\sqrt {L}} \mathrm {e} ^ {\mathrm {i} 2 \pi n x / L}.
$$

对应的能量本征值为

$$
k = \sqrt {\frac {2 m E}{\hbar^ {2}}} = \frac {2 n \pi}{L},
$$

$$
E _ {n} ^ {0} = \frac {2 n ^ {2} \pi^ {2} \hbar^ {2}}{m L ^ {2}} = n ^ {2} E _ {1} ^ {0}.
$$

(b) 微扰矩阵元的一般表达式

$$
\begin{array}{l} H _ {m n} ^ {\prime} = \int_ {0} ^ {L} \psi_ {m} ^ {0 *} (x) H ^ {\prime} \psi_ {n} ^ {0} (x) d x \\ = \int_ {0} ^ {L} \frac {1}{\sqrt {L}} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \mathrm {i} 2 \pi m x / L} V _ {0} \cos \left(2 \pi \frac {x}{L}\right) \frac {1}{\sqrt {L}} \mathrm {e} ^ {\mathrm {i} 2 \pi n x / L} \mathrm {d} x \\ = \frac {V _ {0}}{L} \int_ {0} ^ {L} \mathrm {e} ^ {\mathrm {i} 2 \pi (n - m) x / L} \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {\mathrm {i} 2 \pi x / L} + \mathrm {e} ^ {- \mathrm {i} 2 \pi x / L}}{2} \mathrm {d} x \\ = \frac {V _ {0}}{2 L} \int_ {0} ^ {L} \left[ \mathrm {e} ^ {\mathrm {i} 2 \pi (n - m + 1) x / L} + \mathrm {e} ^ {\mathrm {i} 2 \pi (n - m - 1) x / L} \right] \mathrm {d} x. \\ \end{array}
$$

由于当 $N \neq 0$ 时，

$$
\int_ {0} ^ {L} \mathrm {e} ^ {\mathrm {i} 2 \pi N x / L} \mathrm {d} x = \left. \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {\mathrm {i} 2 \pi N x / L}}{\mathrm {i} 2 \pi N / L} \right| _ {0} ^ {L} = \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {\mathrm {i} 2 \pi N} - 1}{\mathrm {i} 2 \pi N / L} = 0,
$$

当 $N = 0$ 时，积分值为 $L$

困此，微扰矩阵元的通式可以写为

$$
H _ {m n} ^ {\prime} = \frac {V _ {0}}{2} \left(\delta_ {m, n + 1} + \delta_ {m, n - 1}\right).
$$

(c) 对筒并态 $n = \pm 1$ ，构建 $w$ 矩阵

$$
W _ {1, 1} = H _ {1, 1} ^ {\prime} = \frac {V _ {0}}{2} \left(\delta_ {1, 1 + 1} + \delta_ {1, 1 - 1}\right) = \frac {V _ {0}}{2} \left(\delta_ {1, 2} + \delta_ {1, 0}\right) = 0,
$$

$$
W _ {1, - 1} = H _ {1, - 1} ^ {\prime} = \frac {V _ {0}}{2} \left(\delta_ {1, 1 - 1} + \delta_ {1, 1 + 1}\right) = \frac {V _ {0}}{2} \left(\delta_ {1, 0} + \delta_ {1, 2}\right) = 0,
$$

$$
W _ {- 1, 1} = H _ {- 1, 1} ^ {\prime} = \frac {V _ {0}}{2} \left(\delta_ {- 1, 1 + 1} + \delta_ {- 1, 1 - 1}\right) = \frac {V _ {0}}{2} \left(\delta_ {- 1, 2} + \delta_ {- 1, 0}\right) = 0,
$$

$$
W _ {- 1, - 1} = H _ {- 1, - 1} ^ {\prime} = \frac {V _ {0}}{2} \left(\delta_ {- 1, - 1 + 1} + \delta_ {- 1, - 1 - 1}\right) = \frac {V _ {0}}{2} \left(\delta_ {- 1, 0} + \delta_ {- 1, - 2}\right) = 0.
$$

$\mathcal { W } = \left( \begin{array} { l l } { 0 } & { 0 } \\ { 0 } & { 0 } \end{array} \right)$ ，世幢仕

(例仰创)对 $n = \pm 1$ 的态构建 $w ^ { 2 }$ 矩阵，四个二阶矩阵元分别为

$$
\begin{array}{l} W _ {1, 1} ^ {2} = \sum_ {m \neq 1, - 1} \frac {H _ {1 , m} ^ {\prime} H _ {m , 1} ^ {\prime}}{E _ {\pm 1} ^ {0} - E _ {m} ^ {0}} = \frac {\left| H _ {1 , 0} ^ {\prime} \right| ^ {2}}{E _ {\pm 1} ^ {0} - E _ {0} ^ {0}} + \frac {\left| H _ {1 , 2} ^ {\prime} \right| ^ {2}}{E _ {\pm 1} ^ {0} - E _ {2} ^ {0}} \\ = \left(\frac {V _ {0}}{2}\right) ^ {2} \left(\frac {1}{E _ {1} ^ {0}} + \frac {1}{E _ {1} ^ {0} - 2 ^ {2} E _ {1} ^ {0}}\right) = \frac {V _ {0} ^ {2}}{6 E _ {1} ^ {0}}, \\ \end{array}
$$

$$
W _ {1, - 1} ^ {2} = \sum_ {m \neq 1, - 1} \frac {H _ {1 , m} ^ {\prime} H _ {m , - 1} ^ {\prime}}{E _ {\pm 1} ^ {0} - E _ {m} ^ {0}} = \frac {H _ {1 , 0} ^ {\prime} H _ {0 , - 1} ^ {\prime}}{E _ {\pm 1} ^ {0} - E _ {0} ^ {0}} = \left(\frac {V _ {0}}{2}\right) ^ {2} \left(\frac {1}{E _ {1} ^ {0}}\right) = \frac {V _ {0} ^ {2}}{4 E _ {1} ^ {0}},
$$

$$
W _ {- 1, 1} ^ {2} = W _ {1, - 1} ^ {2 *} = \frac {V _ {0} ^ {2}}{4 E _ {1} ^ {0}},
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} W _ {- 1, - 1} ^ {2} = \sum_ {m \neq - 1, - 1} \frac {H _ {- 1 , m} ^ {\prime} H _ {m , - 1} ^ {\prime}}{E _ {\pm 1} ^ {0} - E _ {m} ^ {0}} = \frac {H _ {- 1 , 0} ^ {\prime} H _ {0 , - 1} ^ {\prime}}{E _ {\pm 1} ^ {0} - E _ {0} ^ {0}} + \frac {H _ {- 1 , - 2} ^ {\prime} H _ {- 2 , - 1} ^ {\prime}}{E _ {\pm 1} ^ {0} - E _ {2} ^ {0}} \\ = \left(\frac {V _ {0}}{2}\right) ^ {2} \left(\frac {1}{E _ {1} ^ {0}} + \frac {1}{E _ {1} ^ {0} - 2 ^ {2} E _ {1} ^ {0}}\right) = \frac {V _ {0} ^ {2}}{6 E _ {1} ^ {0}}. \\ \end{array}
$$

因此 $w ^ { 2 }$ 矩阵可写为

$$
\boldsymbol {\mathcal {W}} ^ {2} = \frac {V _ {0} ^ {2}}{1 2 E _ {1} ^ {0}} \left( \begin{array}{c c} 2 & 3 \\ 3 & 2 \end{array} \right).
$$

设能量本征 $\frac { V _ { 0 } ^ { 2 } } { 1 2 E _ { 1 } } \lambda$ ，贝~ $w ^ { 2 }$ 矩阵的久期方程为 .L':'. Dl

$$
\left| \begin{array}{c c} 2 - \lambda & 3 \\ 3 & 2 - \lambda \end{array} \right| = 0, \quad \lambda_ {+} = 5, \quad \lambda_ {-} = - 1.
$$

因此，能量二阶修正为

$$
E _ {+} ^ {2} = \frac {5 V _ {0} ^ {2}}{1 2 E _ {1}}, \quad E _ {-} ^ {2} = - \frac {V _ {0} ^ {2}}{1 2 E _ {1}}.
$$

本征矢为

$$
\left( \begin{array}{c c} 2 & 3 \\ 3 & 2 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c} x \\ y \end{array} \right) = \lambda \left( \begin{array}{c} x \\ y \end{array} \right) \Rightarrow 2 x + 3 y = \lambda x;
$$

$\lambda = 5$ 时，得 $x = y$ 因此归一化本征矢 ${ \frac { 1 } { \sqrt { 2 } } } \left( \begin{array} { l } { 1 } \\ { 1 } \end{array} \right)$ .当 $\lambda = - 1$ 时，得 $x = - y$ 因此归一化本叫卖 ${ \frac { 1 } { \sqrt { 2 } } } \left( \begin{array} { c } { { 1 } } \\ { { - 1 } } \end{array} \right) .$

所以，"好"量子态为无微扰本征态的线性组合，即

$$
\psi_ {+} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \left(\psi_ {1} + \psi_ {- 1}\right) = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \left(\frac {1}{\sqrt {L}} \mathrm {e} ^ {\mathrm {i} 2 \pi x / L} + \frac {1}{\sqrt {L}} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \mathrm {i} 2 \pi x / L}\right) = \sqrt {\frac {2}{L}} \cos \left(\frac {2 \pi x}{L}\right),
$$

$$
\psi_ {-} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \left(\psi_ {1} - \psi_ {- 1}\right) = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \left(\frac {1}{\sqrt {L}} \mathrm {e} ^ {\mathrm {i} 2 \pi x / L} - \frac {1}{\sqrt {L}} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \mathrm {i} 2 \pi x / L}\right) = \mathrm {i} \sqrt {\frac {2}{L}} \sin \left(\frac {2 \pi x}{L}\right).
$$

(e) 对于 $n = \pm 1$ 的态，能量的二阶修正为

$$
\begin{array}{l} E _ {+} = E _ {1} ^ {0} + E _ {1} ^ {2} + E _ {1} ^ {2} = E _ {1} ^ {0} + 0 + \frac {5 V _ {0} ^ {2}}{1 2 E _ {1} ^ {0}} \\ = \frac {2 \pi^ {2} \hbar^ {2}}{m L ^ {2}} + \frac {5 V _ {0} ^ {2}}{1 2} \frac {m L ^ {2}}{2 \pi^ {2} \hbar^ {2}} = \frac {2 \pi^ {2} \hbar^ {2}}{m L ^ {2}} + \frac {5 m L ^ {2} V _ {0} ^ {2}}{2 4 \pi^ {2} \hbar^ {2}}, \\ \end{array}
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} E _ {-} = E _ {- 1} ^ {0} + E _ {- 1} ^ {2} + E _ {- 1} ^ {2} = E _ {1} ^ {0} + 0 - \frac {V _ {0} ^ {2}}{1 2 E _ {1} ^ {0}} \\ = \frac {2 \pi^ {2} \hbar^ {2}}{m L ^ {2}} - \frac {V _ {0} ^ {2}}{1 2} \frac {m L ^ {2}}{2 \pi^ {2} \hbar^ {2}} = \frac {2 \pi^ {2} \hbar^ {2}}{m L ^ {2}} - \frac {m L ^ {2} V _ {0} ^ {2}}{2 4 \pi^ {2} \hbar^ {2}}. \\ \end{array}
$$
